title: SymmetricDiffusers: Learning Discrete Diffusion on Finite Symmetric Groups
reason: Learns distributions over permutations of a fixed item set using riffle shuffles. The team generator chooses categorical contents, not just their order; slot-order invariance is already a planned diagnostic.

title: Enhancing GNNs Performance on Combinatorial Optimization by Recurrent Feature Update
reason: Recurrent GNN features optimize an explicit differentiable QUBO loss; no such battle-strength objective is available and QUBO is parked.

title: RouteExplainer: An Explanation Framework for Vehicle Routing Problem
reason: Explains route edges through counterfactual route costs and a route-intention classifier; does not validate a team-strength surrogate or team-edit effect.

title: A Hierarchical Destroy and Repair Approach for Solving Very Large-Scale Travelling Salesman Problem
reason: Hierarchical compression of retained tour edges targets millions of cities. There is no equivalent safe compression of six interacting Pokemon sets.

title: ML4CO-Bench-101: Benchmark Machine Learning for Classic Combinatorial Problems on Graphs
reason: Useful benchmark code for classic graph problems, but not a team-generation evaluation method. Existing Unify ML4TSP covers the live learned-versus-search attribution question.

title: GOAL: A Generalist Combinatorial Optimization Agent Learning
reason: GOAL anonymous-title variant; inventory independently resolves identity with S022. Generalist routing/subproblem learning is not a new queue addition.

title: Multi-Task Vehicle Routing Solver via Mixture of Specialized Experts under State-Decomposable MDP
reason: Reuses optimal basis routing policies through LoRA experts under a state-decomposable MDP; team synergy is not decomposed into those basis routing constraints.

title: Learning to Segment for Vehicle Routing Problems
reason: Aggregates stable subtours to speed routing search. Retaining a team core is an analogy, without the required safe segment aggregation or a new experiment beyond partial regeneration.

title: Combinatorial optimization: From deep learning to large language models
reason: Broad review of deep-learning and LLM combinatorial optimization; owner explicitly excludes surveys.

title: Survey on Neural Routing Solvers
reason: Survey/taxonomy of routing solvers; outside the owner's no-surveys preference and current six-set generator experiments.

title: LocalEscaper: A Weakly-supervised Framework with Regional Reconstruction for Scalable Neural TSP Solvers
reason: Weak-label training plus regional TSP reconstruction could motivate low-quality-data use, but existing label-quality/data-source axes already test that. No concrete categorical-team training rule established.

title: Memory-Enhanced Neural Solvers for Routing Problems
reason: MEMENTO updates an autoregressive action distribution from per-instance trajectory memory. Requires new prefix/decision memory and adaptation to noisy battle outcomes; not equivalent to existing elite replay in diffusion.

title: Fractional Langevin Dynamics for Combinatorial Optimization via Polynomial-Time Escape
reason: Levy-noise Langevin proposals exploit explicit graph energies. Polynomial escape analysis is not a guarantee for categorical teams evaluated with noisy battles.

title: Solving NP-hard Min-max Routing Problems as Sequential Generation with Equity Context
reason: Equity-Transformer optimizes min-max workloads across vehicle routes, not robustness against opponents or team-generator diversity.

title: ADAPT: Lightweight, Long-Range Machine Learning Force Fields Without Graphs
reason: Atom-coordinate force-field prediction for silicon defects; neither categorical team generation nor the search/update mechanism is studied.

title: A Scalable Lift-and-Project Differentiable Approach For the Maximum Cut Problem
reason: Lift-and-project gradients for a MaxCut quadratic objective require a known analytic graph objective. This is not a transferable battle-based optimizer without a new validated formulation.

title: Obstacle-aware Simultaneous Task and Energy Planning with Ordering Constraints
reason: Obstacle-aware robotic task/energy planning with ordering constraints; scheduling a route is different from choosing full team contents or learning a battle policy.

title: Neural Cluster First, Route Second: One-Shot Capacitated Vehicle Routing via Differentiable Optimal Transport
reason: Differentiable transport assigns customers to capacity-limited routes. It does not provide a validity-preserving representation for species/moves/items/stat constraints.

title: Geometric Algorithms for Neural Combinatorial Optimization with Constraints
reason: Polytope decompositions and rounding can enforce cardinality/matroid constraints, but the project has no tractable feasible-team polytope and no differentiable true objective.

title: Enhancing the Cross-Size Generalization for Solving Vehicle Routing Problems via Continual Learning
reason: Continual learning across ascending route sizes uses regularization/replay. Six-set team generation has no analogous size curriculum; original-data replay is already planned.

title: Towards Unsupervised Training of Matching-based Graph Edit Distance Solver via Preference-aware GAN
reason: Preference GAN computes graph edit distance using known edit-path costs. It does not establish strategic team similarity or noisy win-rate preference learning.

title: Boosting Cross-problem Generalization in Diffusion-Based Neural Combinatorial Solver via Inference Time Adaptation
reason: DIFU-Ada steers a diffusion solver between routing tasks using explicit task energies. Requires a credible differentiable team objective/surrogate and enters deferred reward integration.

title: Unrealized Expectations: Comparing AI Methods vs Classical Algorithms for Maximum Independent Set
reason: Strong evidence that MIS neural methods can lose to KaMIS/greedy; useful context for reading DIFUSCO, but a general baseline warning adds little beyond current attribution checks and existing Unify ML4TSP.

title: Unsupervised Training of Diffusion Models for Feasible Solution Generation in Neural Combinatorial Optimization
reason: IC/DC learns cost-minimizing feasible bipartite assignments for scheduling/ATSP. This neither supplies a team legality decoder nor avoids the missing evaluable task objective.

title: Learning to Solve Combinatorial Optimization under Positive Linear Constraints via Non-Autoregressive Neural Networks
reason: Positive linear constraints and differentiable search fit analytic facility-location/coverage/routing objectives. Those assumptions do not describe the current team generator and battle oracle.

title: Dynamic Job Shop Scheduling via Deep Reinforcement Learning
reason: Dynamic job-shop dispatching policy with dense-reward or evolutionary training; no new team-proposal or noisy selection mechanism is demonstrated.

title: Boosting Generalization in Diffusion-Based Neural Combinatorial Solver via Energy-guided Sampling
reason: Earlier energy-guided-sampling title for arxiv2502.12188, canonical S096. Do not count as a separate addition.

title: Dataless Quadratic Neural Networks for the Maximum Independent Set Problem
reason: Current title Differentiable Quadratic Optimization For The Maximum Independent Set Problem; multiple initializations optimize a specific MIS quadratic objective, outside the active formulation.

title: Boosting Generalization in Diffusion-Based Neural Combinatorial Solver via Inference Time Adaptation
reason: Earlier inference-time-adaptation title for arxiv2502.12188, canonical S096. Do not count as a separate addition.

title: Large Neighborhood Search meets Iterative Neural Constraint Heuristics
reason: Selective MED only when partial regeneration becomes active: separate random/confidence-based slot removal from greedy/stochastic refill. Paper retrains a separate ConsFormer per operator pairing and optimizes constraint penalties; results do not show frozen diffusion achieves stronger or more diverse teams.

title: Pheromone learning-enhanced neural ant colony optimization
reason: Learns ACO pheromone increments from elites plus graph features. A different search-state update is possible, but it requires a new ACO representation and does not improve the current diffusion/CEM loop directly.

title: Graph homophily booster: Reimagining the role of discrete features in heterophilic graph learning
reason: Transforms heterophilic graphs for node prediction. There is no demonstrated graph-homophily bottleneck in this categorical team generator.

title: Multi-Action Self-Improvement for Neural Combinatorial Optimization
reason: Joint assignment/set-prediction loss avoids agent-order penalties in multi-agent routing/scheduling. Not merely slot shuffling: adopting it requires an assignment-based generator/training objective. First run the existing team-order sensitivity diagnostic.

title: N(CO)2 : Neural Combinatorial Optimization with Chance Constraints to Solve Stochastic Orienteering
reason: Chance-constrained stochastic orienteering handles uncertain route costs, not finite-battle estimation uncertainty or learning reliable team rankings.

title: Breaking the Performance Ceiling in Reinforcement Learning requires Inference Strategies
reason: Tests inference strategies on cooperative multi-agent tasks with repeated attempts. Potential battle-policy reference later, but this does not establish safe search on partially observed adversarial Pokemon states or a new team-generation experiment.

title: Solving method of traveling salesman problem based on performer graph self-attention mechanism
reason: Performer graph attention and TSP route refactoring target neural routing architecture/scaling; unrelated to current categorical proposer decisions.

title: Beyond the Heatmap: A Rigorous Evaluation of Component Impact in MCTS-Based TSP Solvers
reason: Shows MCTS tuning can dominate learned heatmap quality; method-attribution check already motivated by active Unify ML4TSP. Keep as corroborating evidence, not another active reading.
